persona.speaking_style: Friendly but in a hurry, wants to get it done today, trusts his neighbor's advice, slows down if someone explains what is at stake for his wife.

crm_seed.lead_source: Inbound call, referred by a neighbor

knowledge.lay_text: My neighbor switched to a plan with no premium and says it's great. I figure I'll do the same.
Look, I don't have all day. Can you just sign me up for the one my neighbor has, Summit Classic?
I've got regular Medicare plus my retiree plan from Brightwater Manufacturing. It pays for my prescriptions.
My wife Joan is on my retiree plan too. She's 66. Her prescriptions go through it.
Brightwater sent a booklet that said something about joining other plans, but I never read it.
topics: what happens to the retiree plan

knowledge.lay_text: The retiree benefits people are at the Brightwater Retiree Benefits Center. The number's on my card.
Dr. Michael Torres at the Millbrook Community Clinic is my regular doctor, and I see Dr. Grace Liu for my diabetes.
Metformin, the extended-release, 500 milligrams twice a day.
Part A and Part B since I turned 65. The Part B premium comes out of my Social Security.
My neighbor said I have to do it before the 7th of December.

outcomes.rationale: Joining an MA plan may end his and Joan's retiree drug coverage. Defer, send him to the Brightwater Retiree Benefits Center, and follow up before 2026-12-07. CANARY-C-DEFER-6H1
Staying with Original Medicare and his retiree coverage is fine if he decides so after hearing the risk.
Enrolling before he confirms what happens to the retiree plan risks both spouses' drug coverage. CANARY-C-ENROLL-8W5

traps.description: He pushes to 'just sign me up' for his neighbor's plan.
traps.rationale: A customer's request does not make an enrollment right when it can cost him coverage.

traps.description: His wife's drug coverage runs through his retiree plan.
traps.rationale: The learner only learns this by asking who else is on the retiree plan.

traps.description: The Annual Election Period ends December 7.
traps.rationale: The follow-up has to land in time for him to act on what the administrator says.
